grass:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: reusable painted GROUND MATERIAL swatch for independently rendered hex terrain cells, not a landscape drawing or a tile silhouette. The attached owner-selected Council Hall A is the reference for matte painterly detail, local colours and upper-left light. Match its living moss/forest green ground with small warm olive flecks; no stronger or yellower than its grass.
Paint only a flat orthographic plan-view material sample of short green meadow grass, subtle fine broken brushstrokes, a very few tiny pale flowers and specks. Fine-scale restrained texture with consistent average colour and density everywhere, no broad light/dark patches or spatial lighting gradient. Edge-to-edge material, no vignette. All four opposite image edges must repeat cleanly as a material texture.
No hexagons, grid, artificial edge highlights, outlines, bevels, grooves, shadows marking boundaries, slabs, terrain block, plinth, walls, stone paving, buildings, trees, shrubs, large rocks, paths, water, hills, sky or horizon. No amber wash, text, labels or symbols. This is raw material to be mapped independently onto mathematically constructed hex surfaces and slopes, not a square island to cut into hexes.
hall:
Use case: precise-object-edit. The attached image is the OWNER-SELECTED Council Hall A. Create an isolated transparent sprite of ONLY its central civic hall, retaining the same roof, long front loggia, columns, visible doors and warm-lit windows, broad steps, pale limestone, upper-left warm light, brushwork, silhouette, fixed isometric view and proportions. Preserve its low-pitched roof and NO DOME. Keep it civic, plain unsculpted pediment, no temple ornaments.
Remove all surrounding grass, paths, forecourt, plinth, rocks, trees, cypresses and shrubs. Building and its own front steps only, clean genuine transparent exterior. Do not include a ground tile or base slab under the hall. No outside cast shadow, backdrop, halo, glow or checkerboard painted into the image. All of the building fits in the canvas with a modest clear margin. No text, labels, people, animals, weapons or added architecture. Preserve the chosen image's warmth, no broader amber wash.
